Trade-space

Cap-safety (x) × wellness continuity D2 (y); bubble = winter thermal D3. ★ = your live edit.
The ★ only MOVES when an edit changes cap-safety or D2 specifically (e.g. pulling the house away from the pool/link) — those two are step-like, not smooth, so most edits (glazing, height, a small nudge) move the numbers above instead and leave the ★ sitting still or barely growing/shrinking. That's still a live update — read the numbers on this line, not just the dot.
A/B/C reference bubbles are always Stage 1 / LOD 100-grade — they never recompute against a promotion. Only the ★ (your live edit) can turn schematic (greyed), and only once a COND volume (house/office/pool/link) is promoted.

Add room

Lands in the middle of the current view at 3×3 m, ready to drag and resize. Rooms are not confined to a mass — a room reaching past its volume is the signal that the volume wants reshaping, which is what a later "reshape to fit" step reads.

Add opening

New openings default to a sensible width, then drag the two small square handles to stretch, the round handle to slide, or the ⌫ button to delete.

Violations & notes

Schematic block diagram — proportions approximate the program table, not a scaled architectural plan. Rooms drag freely; doors/windows/casework slide along the wall they're already assigned to (like a door), but don't re-snap to a different wall if dragged off it. Each door/window has a round slide handle, two square stretch handles, and a red × to delete. The upper link's stair hatching is a location marker only — not a calculated stair (no rise/run/going check).

Hub clearance — Great Room walls

Merges each wall's door keep-clear bands + fixed casework spans (per the circulation-first rule), same idea as a veranda-loop check, applied to GR as the zero-corridor hub (D5). Ground level only — the hub is on Ground.
